CloudTalk gives engineering teams a REST API to automate call center operations: managing calls, contacts, agents, numbers, SMS, campaigns, and AI-powered conversation intelligence. This documentation covers everything you need to integrate with the CloudTalk API.

[**Introduction** \\
\\
Overview of the CloudTalk API, its capabilities, and how it works.](https://help.cloudtalk.io/guides/introduction)

[**Quickstart** \\
\\
Make your first API call in under 5 minutes.](https://help.cloudtalk.io/guides/quickstart)

[**Authentication** \\
\\
Set up HTTP Basic Auth with your API keys.](https://help.cloudtalk.io/guides/authentication)

[**API Reference** \\
\\
Full reference for every endpoint, with live playground.](https://help.cloudtalk.io/api-reference/overview)

## [​](https://help.cloudtalk.io/developers\#what-you-can-build)  What You Can Build

## Call Automation

Trigger outbound calls, fetch call history, download recordings, and access real-time call flow data.

## Contact Management

Create and sync contacts, manage tags, notes, activities, and custom attributes.

## AI Insights

Pull transcriptions, sentiment analysis, smart notes, topics, and talk-listen ratios from calls.

## SMS & WhatsApp

Send SMS and WhatsApp messages programmatically from your CloudTalk numbers.

## VoiceAgent

Initiate AI-powered voice agent calls using your configured VoiceAgent IDs.

## [​](https://help.cloudtalk.io/developers\#explore-the-api)  Explore the API

[**API Concepts** \\
\\
Learn about response envelopes, pagination, error codes, and rate limiting.](https://help.cloudtalk.io/guides/response-envelopes)
